title: ClearPath Loyalty Multiplier on TimeBank Extension Fees
content:
**Extension loyalty schedule.** On a TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours extension, a client whose ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement is active at ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise and has renewed at least once has the fee multiplied by 0.5; a client whose ClearPath agreement is active at ClearPath Professional or ClearPath Standard and has renewed at least once, by 0.75; any other client, by 1. Renewal is read from the number of renewal terms the active agreement's record shows as started since its initial term.

| Active ClearPath tier | Renewal terms started | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| ClearPath Premier or Enterprise | 1 or more | 0.5 |
| ClearPath Professional or Standard | 1 or more | 0.75 |
| any tier | 0 (still in the initial term) | 1 |
| ClearPath Essentials or Monitor, or no active agreement | any | 1 |

Hypothetical case: a fee of 400.00 before this multiplier becomes 200.00 for a renewed ClearPath Premier client and 300.00 for a renewed ClearPath Standard client.
